changeSet.comment: Create initial admin user (Administrateur) with email notification@cosumaf.org and bcrypt password
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO t_user ( c_id, c_created_at, c_updated_at, c_firstname, c_lastname, c_email, c_password, c_phone, c_account_enabled, c_account_locked, c_account_expired, c_credential_expired, c_mfa_enabled, c_total_login_attempt, c_actor_id ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), NULL, NULL, 'Administrateur', 'notification@cosumaf.org', '$2a$10$gzM3IFwLQDqslnncBo10AePRARXbnlVa9Qt2U0z8KJsLwumhHSL12', NULL, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, 0, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user WHERE c_email = 'notification@cosumaf.org' );

INSERT INTO t_user_role (c_user_id, c_role_id) SELECT u.c_id, r.c_id FROM t_user u JOIN t_role r ON r.c_code = 'ADMIN' WHERE u.c_email = 'notification@cosumaf.org' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_role ur WHERE ur.c_user_id = u.c_id AND ur.c_role_id = r.c_id );
